def _norm(name):
    name = name.strip()
    if name.endswith(":latest"):
        name = name[:-len(":latest")]
    return name


def installed(world, M=None, X=None):
    try:
        names = list(world.machines())
    except Exception:
        return []
    if M is not None:
        names = [m for m in names if m == M]
    wanted = _norm(X) if X is not None else None
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for m in names:
        try:
            r = world.run(m, "ollama", "list")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if r.rc != 0:
            continue
        for i, line in enumerate((r.out or "").splitlines()):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if not parts:
                continue
            if parts[0].upper() == "NAME" and i == 0:
                continue
            model = _norm(parts[0])
            if wanted is not None and model != wanted:
                continue
            key = (m, model)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(key)
    return result
